change_summary: PLOS ONE issued an expression of concern on this paper. It flags a possible discontinuity in the Fig. 4 LSD1 blot and a Fig. 7 that doesn't match its legend or the migration text. It also notes missing control details for the transfection experiments and similarities with other groups' work that question validity and provenance. The authors did not respond, so the issues remain unresolved.
evaluation: Your draft cites [12] twice. Section 2 uses it for the tissue finding that LSD1 is higher in lung cancer than normal lung. Section 3 uses its Figure 7 migration result as the main evidence for your central hypothesis. The notice says Fig. 7 does not correspond to its legend or the Results text, so the Section 3 use is touched and matters moderately. The notice does not name the tissue data in Section 2, but says similarities with other groups' work question the validity of the reported results, so that use is uncertain.
recommendation: Hedge the Section 3 migration claim and don't build on it, because the notice says "The results shown in Fig. 7 do not correspond to the description in the Figure legend or the corresponding text of the Results section." Also hedge the Section 2 tissue finding and cite the notice, since "Similarities were noted between this article [1] and work by other research groups which call into question the validity and provenance of the reported results."
